build_dflash_draft_model: build a DFlash draft model for speculative decoding using SGLang primitives without token embeddings or LM head
run_dflash_forward_pass: run a forward pass on the DFlash draft model with input embeddings and positions
load_dflash_weights: load stacked QKV and gate_up weights into a DFlash draft model from checkpoint tensors
build_dflash_attention: build a DFlash attention layer with QKV projection, per-head QK RMSNorm, RoPE, and encoder-only RadixAttention
build_dflash_mlp: build a DFlash MLP block with merged gate/up projections and SiLU activation
